# HWL by SMD

> Beauty, movement, ritual practices, products, and experiences by Shannon Mary Dixon, online and in Palm Springs, Joshua Tree, and the surrounding desert.

HWL by SMD is Shannon Mary Dixon's practice exploring beauty, body, and being. LIFT is a seven-movement, approximately five-minute facial massage ritual. The complete LIFT offer includes a guided video and downloadable PDF. Current price and availability are authoritative on the canonical LIFT page. LIFT is general wellness education, not medical or dermatological care.

## LIFT

- [LIFT: A Daily Facial Massage Ritual](https://www.hwlbysmd.com/beauty/lift): Canonical public product and learning page.
- [Beauty](https://www.hwlbysmd.com/beauty): Shannon's public beauty practice and facial ritual overview.

## Services and booking

- [Book a Session](https://www.hwlbysmd.com/book): Canonical booking journey for Shannon's live availability and session requests.
- [Body](https://www.hwlbysmd.com/yoga): Private yoga, movement, and sound experiences.
- [Being](https://www.hwlbysmd.com/astrology): Tarot, Reiki, and reflective ritual experiences.
- [Retreats](https://www.hwlbysmd.com/retreats): Private group and retreat experiences.

## Store
